nodes.body: This repairs newly emitted source-language intents: English has no self-translation candidate to approve, so it uses :none, matching the existing generated-draft constructor. Spanish retains :required and the unchanged exact candidate/content/source/output approval laws. The preceding resource fields still declare :withheld and :source/current, so a save does not publish and unresolved source cannot pass. The red regression failed twice under the original policy; the repaired domain run passes 3 tests / 26 assertions. Existing manifests retain their declared review fields; this change intentionally requires a fresh document or a separately reviewed policy edit for existing resources.

nodes.body: The caller can be Services, so the checkout default would resolve main in Services rather than Knoxx. The explicit repository appears in all four jobs (source, integration-e2e, mutation and qualified), ensuring the selected SHA, local setup action, mutation source and accepting verifier come from Knoxx. Credential persistence stays disabled; source still must be an immutable commit reachable from Knoxx main, and all downstream jobs use that selected SHA. scripts/test-production-checkout.py checks all four bindings and is invoked by the eta-mu deterministic evidence gate. This repairs source custody; it does not supply a passing integration/e2e or four-batch mutation qualification.

nodes.body: This digest comes from the immutable source actually saved through native CMS HTTP creation and read through the production source resolver, rather than a fabricated revision fact. The surrounding assertions hydrate persisted EN/ES intents and prove withheld English denial, published English admission without self-translation work, and Spanish evidence blockers. The existing Fastify suite passes 7 tests / 95 assertions. scripts/verify-cms-history.sh now uses the canonical error preload and testCountersExitCode: a fatal asynchronous error must fail before PASS output even when Shadow prints zero failures. The wrapper bounds both runs. Seeded auth principals and a local server are explicit limits; deployed image, password login, real provider, browser and artifact materialization proof remain in the linked verification guide.
